title: Tracks that are currently taking over the industry by storm in 2023
htmlContent:
To stand out in music, especially a genre like Hip-Hop, an artist has to have a presence not only the presence but commanding energy to them that makes you invest in their artistry, which they present for us to buy. That separates an artist whom you only give one listen and whom you keep up with.

Below is the list of music stars who have taken the time to give us their very best in releasing their songs. 

Here is the list of incredible songs that you must hear this week:

  • Lalanne - Same Old Story

Lalanne's "Same Old Story" is her first single and the first song Lalanne has written. The incredible single is about the story of Lalanne's life - the heartbreak of her parent's passing when she was young, the emotional chaos that ensued, and her journey to loving herself. Fused with an undying melody, "Same Old Story" is a track that will leave a mark in the industry.

For more, stay connected to Lalanne below:

Instagram | Spotify

  • Day Nah - Baby Cosmic Crazy

Day Nah, on his recent track "Baby Cosmic Crazy," is an incredible display of jazz, blues-rock, retro soul, and funk that hits every mark with each line standing out. This stunning piece is solely based on a fascination with the 1960-1970s hippie era. "Baby Cosmic Crazy" can be seen as "a love anthem towards one's future self." The iconic Janis Joplin and the genius multi-instrumentalist Tash Sultana inspire this future alter-ego.

For more, stay connected to Day Nah below:

Instagram | Spotify | Facebook

  • Dawson Bailey - Two Faced

Dawson Bailey, on his recent track "Two Faced," takes his time to put on a show for his established and new fans to love. He releases a sound that is true to the culture, filled with edge and a willingness to go against the grain that pays significant dividends for this talented emcee.The American rapper has released his signature sound, which keeps his fans returning for more.

For more, stay connected to Dawson Bailey below:

Instagram | Spotify | Facebook 

  • Tve Bandz - Take Me Down

Tve Bandz's "Take Me Down" is an incredible work. This talented rapper made the track to tell the world how he felt when it looked like the world was against him. The talented rapper Tve Bandz is an open book that holds nothing back in his art. He finds music his safest space, where he can honestly tell the world how he feels.

For more, stay connected to Tve Bandz below:

Instagram | Tik-Tok | Spotify

  • Carla Lina - If I Lose You

Carla Lina's "If I Lose You" is fantastic work. It is a ballad that immediately grabs everyone with a theme that gets under your skin. "If I Lose You" is pure goosebumps. Here, Carla Lina shows her vulnerable side in this ballad, her greatest fear that so many people can relate to and learn from, especially with the loss of a loved one. Carla Lina wrote this song when her mother had breast cancer, and the greatest fear of losing her mother suddenly seemed natural. The talented singer and songwriter's song "If I Lose You" is a must-have because everyone who hears this song feels the message behind the track.
